evidence.reason: The resolver merges each size threshold independently with `f ?? c ?? default` and returns the resolved size block without checking the resulting tier ordering. Thus a flag-level small threshold can exceed a config-level medium threshold, producing an inverted small/medium policy that per-source validation would not catch. This is an implementation defect in the intended tier semantics, not merely a new hardening request.
